global_settings_nav_description: Settings shared by all CZN mods.
action_count_enabled_desc: Counted monsters act after you play a number of cards, even mid-turn.
czn_monsters_enabled_desc: Adds custom CZN monsters to the run. Off keeps the original game content.
boss_pos_random_desc: CZN bosses join the native boss pool; whether and where they appear is decided by the original game.
boss_pos_specified_desc: Place the chosen CZN boss in the selected act only.
boss_select_desc: Which boss to place in the chosen act. Random picks a CZN boss that has not appeared this run.
boss_hp_custom_desc: For testing only. Overrides the boss HP with the value below.
boss_hp_value_desc: 1-9999, step 1. Only used when Custom Boss HP is on.
